`LogoClim` operates on a grid of patches, where each patch represents a geographical area and stores values for latitude, longitude, and selected climate variables. During the simulation, patches update their colors based on the data values. The results can be visualized on a map, accompanied by plots that display the mean, minimum, maximum, and standard deviation of the selected variable over time.

```{=html}
<p align="center">
  <img src="images/logoclim-interface-fra-30s-hcd.png" style="max-width: 100%;" />
</p>
```

The model allows simulations using all three climate data series from [WorldClim 2.1](https://worldclim.org/). These series are offered at various spatial resolutions, ranging from 10 minutes (~340 km² at the equator) to 30 seconds (~1 km² at the equator), and can be chosen within the model interface to suit your research requirements.

Learn more about the data series in the [WorldClim](@sec-worldclim) section.
